name: mcp-window-describe-pages
description: A row of window_describe whose JSON text alone passes the bound of a page is the only row of its page with its value cut, and the next page, read from a new snapshot from which an entry was removed and to which one was added, starts after the key of that row; the compact form cuts a long status value at 200 characters and an element at 20 items with itemsTotal.
reason: The snapshots change between calls and hold a value whose length the test gives, which a running application does not show on demand.
